data_model:
Baseline: commit 2f158e27 (S439 DAMAGESHOW1, 07:57 today) plus uncommitted in-flight edits by another session (scripts/ui/ResultMarks.gd new, BodyCallouts.gd, FightNight.gd, AfterFight.gd - modified 07:58-07:59 while this check ran).
BodyMap (scripts/rules/BodyMap.gd, pure): PLACES head, left_eye, right_eye, nose, left_ribs, right_ribs (5); FACE_PLACES eyes + nose (6). fresh() 27-34 = {a/b: {places 100 each, cuts, relief, closed}}. Bands band() 124-131: fine > 55, hurt 35-55, critical 15-35, doctor <= 15. Hits _punch_hits 46-80: FACE_HIT 1.15 to nose or an eye + HEAD_HIT 0.575 (x1.5 hooks/uppercuts); body_hook RIB_HIT 3.1 to one rib side (defender's liver side 60%); big x2. add_beats 83-112: an open (not closed) cut takes x1.5; a face place reaching <= 35 gets cuts[place]=true for the rest of the bout - so every cut is on a place already 'badly hurt'. corner() 177-199: enswell lifts an eye to the next band via relief, 'cut' sets closed for every cut, ice adds rib relief. end_round() 202-205 clears relief and closed. value() 115-121 = place + relief, max 100.
end_round runs at EVERY bell including the last: FightView._bell 404 and skip_round 477 call BodyLive.bell, and BoutMarks.build calls it per round. So on the result page relief and closed are always empty: values are the raw places, cuts are all open, and no eye is 'closed'.
Where the map lives: BodyLive (fight3d/BodyLive.gd:16), attached by FightHud.gd:29; attach() shares it as main.modal["body_map"] and modal["bodies"] (34-36); bell() counts modal["body_bells"] (134-135, new). FightCast copies it to the corner card (105). NEW in 2f158e27: AfterFight.book (30-40) replaces m.body_map with BoutMarks.build(c, f, m) whenever BoutMarks.seen_all(m) is false (no map, or fewer bells than rounds: Skip bout, a words bout, headless) - the settled rounds' exchanges -> ExchangeBeats.build (seed c.day*97+n) -> add_beats, no corner work replayed. So every bout's result has a map; round pages before the end still have none for unwatched rounds. m.bodies is set only by BodyLive; the in-flight AfterFight edit fills it from Faces.pair for unwatched bouts.
Words per level, five sets now: BodyTip.BAND_WORDS (BodyTip.gd:15), CalloutLine HEAD_WORDS / BODY_WORDS (CalloutLine.gd:17-19), Aftermath 'sore' / 'badly hurt' with PLACE_WORDS (Aftermath.gd:13-14, 103-112), and the in-flight ResultMarks WORD fine/sore/badly hurt with PLACE labels where right_ribs = 'LIVER' and left_ribs = 'RIBS' (ResultMarks.gd PLACE/WORD) while Aftermath says 'Right ribs'.
BodyReport (rules/BodyReport.gd) is muscle burn, not damage; BoutNight._finish 439-456 stores m.body_report, m.body_change and f.last_body_report.
What persists on the fighter (BoutNight._finish 326-459; order: ... body report 439-456, Injuries.after_bout 457, AfterFight.book 458): f.injury {type cut|nose|head|hand|ribs|ko, days_out, until_day, choice, why} until Injuries.day_tick clears it (230-239), no side or place; f.stand_down {band, damage, head, open_day} from the FIGHT MODEL's m.damage.a (StandDown.head_place = 100 - dmg x 2.2; fine >= 55, unlike BodyMap's > 55), {} after a stoppage loss; f.ko_history (+day on a stoppage loss); f.durability_cap lowered by Attrs.wear_stoppage (BoutNight.gd:371); f.week_fatigue = Aftermath.toll (AfterFight.gd:34); f.last_body_report; record, morale, rank. Nothing of BodyMap (places, cuts) is written to f or the Career: grep finds no f["body_map"]; BoutMarks writes only m. The injury roll (Injuries.gd:186-194) reads head from m.damage and eyes/nose/ribs from m.body_map - but it runs BEFORE AfterFight.book, so for an unwatched bout it sees head only.
What the result page is handed (m = main.modal): body_map (always since 2f158e27), body_bells, bodies (watched; in flight: always), body_track, body_report, body_change, injury, damage, rounds, stopped, outcome, cards, why, rank_words, aftermath (six tile dicts), members_lost, tickets/gym_cut/club_cut, ladder.
face_marks:
2D: scripts/ui/FaceMarks.gd, pure vector drawing on a CanvasItem, no textures. marks(vals, side, at) 43-60 uses the three face places only: 'shut' when side.closed[eye] (dark oval + slit), else 'swell' when the eye <= 55 (k = (55-v)/55 + 0.35, clamped 0.35..1; three squashed purple circles), 'cut' on the brow (at + BROW) when side.cuts[eye] - drawn even when that cut is closed - a red 'nose' circle when nose <= 55, a nose 'cut' when cuts.nose (the nose cut ignores closed). Positions in close-up radii: fixed AT (14) or layout() 27-40 from assets/ui/face/promo_face.json via BodyHolo._face_uv. The face under the marks is BodyHolo.portrait's 'face' = assets/ui/face/<stem>.jpg, the studio photo the json was measured on - so the close-up and its marks agree; the risk is only for menu portraits (PromoShot default ui_art 'b', the comic repaint, with a breathing sway).
Callers: only BodyCallouts._draw_card (HEAD card, skipped when live_pop). Live round: off (BodyPanels go_live). Corner overlay: on, but only while the mouse is on her head, and 'shut' never shows there (closed is empty until apply_body runs after the pick). Result page: at HEAD none; in the working tree ResultMarks.figure attaches BodyCallouts, passes map[side] as marks and calls pin(46), so the HEAD card stays out with swell / red nose / cut for each boxer whose face place is sore or cut ('shut' never, closed is cleared at the last bell). The BodyFigure on all these pages is the SHARED holo figure (BodyFigure.portrait_for -> BodyHolo.portrait when BodyHolo.has()), so only the HEAD card is really her.
3D hooks on the MetaHuman: (a) Decals on the head bone, as FighterFace._scars (149-174) does for record scars: BoneAttachment3D 'FighterScars' on 'Head', a rest-space Node3D, one Decal per spot (procedural _scar texture 177-192, cull_mask 1). SCAR_AT (12-18) has measured brow_l, brow_r, cheek_l, cheek_r, nose positions (rest space, metres, eyes y 1.587, x +-0.0305) - brow and nose match BodyMap's cut places; eye swelling would need new spots under each eye. Decals project over both art modes. (b) Skin: the face is its own surface MH_Skin_Head (MHRig.gd:100) with its own mh_skin ShaderMaterial per body (MHRig.gd:165-173); mh_skin.gdshader has tint, sheen (sweat), roughness etc. but no bruise or mask uniform, and with art=toon ArtStyle._twin (135-165) replaces it with a toon material, so a bruise uniform must go in both shaders. (c) Eyes: every MH_Eye surface gets a fresh ShaderMaterial on assets/shaders/mh_eye.gdshader with the fighter's one 'lid' value (FighterFace.gd:89-98; uniform 'lid' 0 wide..1 shut at line 11, plus 'blink'); FighterLife drives only 'blink' (FighterLife.gd:195). Whether the left and right eye are separate surfaces (needed to close one eye) is not verified. The materials come back as face["eyes"] (BoxerBuild.gd:51, 179). (d) Reach: BodyLive._apply (56-85) is the per-punch moment; FighterFace.apply is skipped with '-- nolook'; VersusLive and PadWork build bodies through MHRig without FighterFace, so a FighterFace-based layer would not reach them. No damage textures exist.
result_page:
Built by FightNight._result (scripts/ui/modals/FightNight.gd:263-357 at HEAD): 'THE RESULT' header, a hero row with her figure (287), the winner, method, judges' cards or 'Stopped in round n', MatchStats strip and bars, and the opponent's figure (320); the aftermath row (322-323, AftermathTiles.build: big word, a 2-line small line, the rest in the tile's tooltip); WhyCard (325); 'What decided it' with the body-report focus button (_decided 233-260); the ribbon (ticket cut or purse, members, INJURY REPORT when m.injury, 327-344); 'The plan, lit up'; Back home. Tiles come from Aftermath.tiles (55-57): DAMAGE, TIREDNESS, LEARNED, MORALE, YOUR CORNER, RANK (RANK dropped for a pro, AfterFight.gd:59-60), computed in BoutNight._finish -> AfterFight.book after Injuries.after_bout.
'Nothing lasting' (Aftermath.gd:98, commit 2f158e27): the DAMAGE tile's starting text ONLY when facts.places is non-empty (the bout has a map); with no map it starts as '<N> punches taken' (tone flat). It is then replaced by '<worst place> sore' / '<worst place> badly hurt' when any of her six places is out of the fine band (<= 55), by 'Cut' when a face place is cut and none is sore (unreachable in play: a cut needs <= 35), and by 'Injured' when m.injury is set (always on a stoppage loss: InjuryRoll gives a 'ko' suspension). So it is false only when she ends with every place above 55 and no cut and no injury. Since 2f158e27 every bout has a map (BoutMarks for a skipped, words or headless bout; the live map only when BodyLive rang every bell), and the relief question is settled: the last bell's end_round clears relief and closed before the page. The tile now lists every sore place (worst first) and every cut, and its hover says 'Marks heal on their own before the next bout. Only an injury keeps <her> out.' - still nothing of the map is kept on the fighter, so 'lasting' / 'heal' is a statement with no stored state or clock behind it.
Hero figures: at HEAD RoundGraphics.body (shared holo + band SPOTS, no callouts); for an unwatched bout at HEAD m.bodies is missing, so the figure is BodyFigure's drawn fallback silhouette with an ellipse per place. In the working tree (uncommitted): ResultMarks.figure + BodyCallouts.pin give both figures pinned close-ups on hooked lines (HEAD 46 px with her face and FaceMarks, LIVER, RIBS) for every sore or cut place, and AfterFight fills m.bodies from Faces.pair.

A portrait-afterwards mark needs a per-fighter snapshot, and the new hover line 'Marks heal on their own before the next bout' has no clock behind it - do not invent a healing rate under 'Stop, show damage'; reuse f.injury.until_day or f.stand_down.open_day or ask.

Two head numbers: BodyMap's head place versus the fight model's m.damage.a that drives StandDown and the injury roll's head. StandDown also cuts at head >= 55 = fine while BodyMap calls 55 'hurt', and a 'fine' head still locks 5 days of sparring with no news line (the line fires only when band != 'fine').

CornerOverlay prints 'No cut, no swollen eye: the cutman waits.' for EVERY amateur corner (opts is [] when not _pro, CornerOverlay.gd:317, 326) - a seen false statement when she is cut or swollen; fix under the 'fix a seen defect now' rule.

Five word sets now for the same bands: BodyTip, CalloutLine head/body, Aftermath ('Right ribs badly hurt') and the in-flight ResultMarks ('LIVER 30 - badly hurt' for the same right_ribs). The tile and the pinned card under it can name the same place differently.
FaceMarks draws a brow cut even when the cutman closed it (closed only changes the eye to 'shut'), and a nose cut ignores closed. Porting marks() to 3D as-is keeps that.
Live-round face marks are off on purpose (go_live: brain card, S405 look); turning them on changes an approved look.
f.injury stores a type but no side or place: a 'cut' injury cannot be put on the right brow from saved data.

File sizes were understated: BodyCallouts.gd is 376 lines in the working tree, FightNight.gd 392, CornerOverlay.gd 401 (first audit: ~340, ~360, ~390). New drawing goes in a new small file (as ResultMarks does).
3D decals are 2-3 cm at SCAR_AT and the broadcast camera is far: they will read mostly on the 1.5 s close-up and the corner film. The 3D view never decides: it reads BodyLive's map, never changes it.

His S437 rule (hooked line out of the body, never blobs on the chest): at HEAD the round, corner and result figures still use the skin SPOT tint, and the unwatched result uses drawn ellipses; the in-flight pinned hooked lines answer it only on the result page.
